# {Vectorized guided local search update incorporating a subtle memory decay on penalized edges to dissipate historical distortions while selectively penalizing maximal-utility tour edges based on usage counts.}

import numpy as np

def update_edge_distance(edge_distance, local_opt_tour, edge_n_used):
    updated_edge_distance = np.copy(edge_distance)
    
    # Vectorized edge indexing of the current local optimal tour
    u_idx = local_opt_tour
    v_idx = np.roll(local_opt_tour, -1)
    
    tour_lengths = edge_distance[u_idx, v_idx]
    tour_counts = edge_n_used[u_idx, v_idx]
    
    # Calculate edge utility based on length and frequency of inclusion
    utilities = tour_lengths / (1.0 + tour_counts)
    max_utility = np.max(utilities)
    avg_edge = np.mean(tour_lengths)
    
    # Dissipate accumulated penalties across historically penalized edges (decay towards original topology)
    penalized_mask = edge_n_used > 0
    decay_factor = 0.995
    updated_edge_distance[penalized_mask] *= decay_factor
    
    # Penalize the highest-utility edge(s) in the current tour
    penalty = 0.3 * avg_edge
    threshold = 0.99 * max_utility
    selected_mask = utilities >= threshold
    
    sel_u = u_idx[selected_mask]
    sel_v = v_idx[selected_mask]
    
    # Maintain symmetric distance matrix updates without Python loops
    updated_edge_distance[sel_u, sel_v] += penalty
    updated_edge_distance[sel_v, sel_u] += penalty
    
    return updated_edge_distance
